# Golden DB fingerprint captured from the pre-port (OLD) build.
# Row counts:
linkquality_daily_summary 1
linkquality_samples 27
log_events 12
network_snapshots 1
sqlite_sequence 3
# .schema:
CREATE TABLE linkquality_samples (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  device_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  ieee_address TEXT,
  lqi INTEGER NOT NULL,
  ts DATETIME NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq);
CREATE INDEX idx_lqi_device_ts ON linkquality_samples(device_name, ts);
CREATE TABLE network_snapshots (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts DATETIME NOT NULL,
  raw_json TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE log_events (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts DATETIME NOT NULL,
  event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  device_name TEXT,
  message TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_type_ts ON log_events(event_type, ts);
CREATE TABLE linkquality_daily_summary (
  device_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  day TEXT NOT NULL,
  min_lqi INTEGER,
  max_lqi INTEGER,
  avg_lqi REAL,
  sample_count INTEGER,
  PRIMARY KEY (device_name, day)
);
